**SG13CMOS5L_LPSVS**  
   
 Low-Power Voltage Supervisor (LPSVS) for 1.2 V core supply monitoring, integrating Power-On Reset (POR), Brown-Out Reset (BOR), hysteresis-based voltage detection, and reset-delay functionality.  
****LPVSV Block Description: ****  
**Analog/ Mixed Signal IP Block**  
   
 **Low Power**   **Voltage Supervisor (*****LPVSV*****)** that monitors the ***1V2*** regulated supply generated (  ***VCORE***) by the on-chip   ***LDO***. The supervisor  ***LPVSV ***ensures reliable startup and operation of the digital core by generating Power-On reset (  ***POR***) and Brown-Out Reset (  ***BOR***) signals whenever the regulated outside its safe operating range.  
   
 The ***LPVSV ***assert  ***RESET ***during startup until the  ***1V2 ***reaches its normal value and remain stable for a predefine delay. During normal operation, if the  ***1V2***drops below the brown out threshold due to an  ***LDO ***failure, overload or supply disturbance, the  ***LPVSV ***immediately deasserts  ***RESET ***to protect the digital core.

**##** ** xschem Configuration**This project includes an `xschemrc` file that automatically configures xschem to find the PDK libraries, regardless of whether the PDK is installed in the `/foss` directory (from IIC-OSIC-TOOLS) or elsewhere. **###** ** How It Works**The `xschemrc` file:- Adds search paths for PDK files based on PDK location- Adds the current working directory to the search path- Allows referencing circuits in the working directory without absolute paths- Makes the entire circuit design more portable **###** ** Usage**To use this configuration with xschem:```bash **#** ** Option 1: Use the project's xschemrc directly**xschem -r ./xschemrc your_schematic.sch **#** ** Option 2: Copy to your xschem directory**cp xschemrc ~/.xschem/xschemrc **#** ** Option 3: Set environment variable**export XSCHEM_RCFILE=./xschemrcxschem your_schematic.sch  
   
**Target Specifications**  
Since the ***LDO*** output specification is **1.2 V ±10%**, the ***LPVSV*** thresholds should be based on that.  
   
    
   
 | | | | | | |  
   
 |-|-|-|-|-|-|  
   
 | **Parameter** |  **Symbol** |  **Min** |  **Typ** |  **Max** |  **Unit** |  
   
 | Supply Voltage | ***VDD*** | 2.7 | 3.3 | 3.6 | V |  
   
 | Temperature | ***T*** | -40 | 27 | 125 | °C |  
   
 | Monitored Voltage | ***VCORE*** | 0 | 1.2 | 1.3 | V |  
   
 | Power-On Threshold | ***Vth_H*** | 1.02 | 1.08 | 1.14 | V |  
   
 | Brown-Out Threshold | ***Vth_L*** | 0.94 | 1 | 1.06 | V |  
   
 | Hysteresis | ***HYS*** | 50 | 80 | 100 | mV |  
   
 | Threshold Accurancy | ***TH_AC*** | - | ±5 | ±7.5 | % |  
   
 | Quiescent Current | ***IQ*** | - | 5 | 10 | uA |  
   
 | Reset Delay | ***RDT*** |  ***3*** |  ***5*** |  ***6*** | mS |
